description: Transcribe a Voice Memos recording, extract action items via the configured LLM, and create Reminders. Commits by default in agent mode; pass dryRun=true to preview.

confirmToken.description: Only after a confirmation_required error: the confirmToken it returned, with the same arguments, to carry out the call.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A repeat of this key with the same arguments within 24 hours returns the first result with replayed=true and does nothing.

memo.description: Memo UUID or prefix (default: most recent recording).

provider.description: AI provider: ollama, claude, or openai (default: ai.provider, else ollama).

title: memos_capture_to_reminders: arguments
